messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 1845001234 - CascadeBank dedicated VPC pool - elevated error rate and log samples contain unredacted PII. Paging oncall.

Asha (oncall): I'm on it. Paging SRE + Security. Can someone confirm the customer impact?

Ruth-CS: CascadeBank reporting failures for tenant cascade-bank-prod around 09:12 UTC. They're seeing retries & higher latencies; they asked us to preserve logs for postmortem but also flagged PII concerns. Customer rep (Dan) is on this thread.

Dan (CascadeBank): yep we need logs for a legal review. Some payloads include ssn-like numbers. We cannot provide raw logs to any external.

Miguel SRE: I can repro error pattern in the dedicated pool. We're seeing backend 503s during model load retries, and our verbose logs captured entire request/response bodies. Example (redact shown inline):
```
[09:13:02] request_id=abc123 tenant=cascade-bank-prod input="Transfer to account 123-45-6789 for $200"
[09:13:02] response=error code=MODEL_LOAD_FAIL
```

Miguel SRE: That's the problem — current debug config dumped full request bodies to logs. We should avoid exporting those.

Priya Sec: We need a controlled retention exception if ops require raw logs to debug. Legal must sign off. Also consider creating a scrubbed snapshot (PII replaced) for initial triage.

Sam EngRuntime: For immediate mitigation I can flip runtime flag to stop full body logging and enable structured metadata only: `REDUCE_VERBOSE_LOGGING=true`. That will stop new PII from being logged. But historical logs are already persisted to S3 retention bucket `rb-logs-dedicated-cascade`.

Asha (oncall): Action list: 1) stop new PII logs (Sam) 2) snapshot current error state + preserve trace id map (Miguel) 3) request legal exception for short-term access (Priya + LegalOpsBot) 4) coordinate with customer on sharing scrubbed diagnostics (Ruth + Dan). Timebox all access to 48h. Anyone object? :hourglass:  

Sam EngRuntime: flipping flag now. running: `./deploy-config --env cascade-bank-prod --set REDUCE_VERBOSE_LOGGING=true`

IncidentBot: deploy job started (job-4421). Logs: https://ci/reports/job-4421

Miguel SRE: Creating an encrypted snapshot of logs for authorized access only. Will generate a KMS-wrapped bundle and a cryptographic hash for chain of custody. Command: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://rb-logs-dedicated-cascade/2026-... /tmp/snapshot && tar czf snapshot.tgz /tmp/snapshot && aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/rb-legal --plaintext fileb://snapshot.tgz --output text --query CiphertextBlob > snapshot.enc
```

Priya Sec: Do NOT share snapshot until Legal signs exception. I'll open a legal request: need justification, retention window, access list, and proof we minimized scope. Offense to GDPR if we share without consent.

Ruth-CS: CascadeBank accepts timeboxed access for debugging and will sign an NDA addendum. Dan: can you confirm who on your side will review?

Dan (CascadeBank): I'll approve only 2 named engineers: Miguel SRE and Sam EngRuntime. We will sign the addendum ASAP.

Priya Sec: Good — please have them provide corporate emails. Also we should pseudonymize obvious PII in a derived copy for fast triage: replace digits with `X` except last 2. I can run a redaction job if legal okays.

LegalOpsBot: New legal request created LR-2026-081. Required fields: scope, duration, approvers (internal + customer), retention deletion proof. Assigned to @LegalTeam.

Asha (oncall): Miguel, proceed to create the encrypted snapshot but DO NOT decrypt or share until we have LR-2026-081 approved. Keep the snapshot in the secured staging bucket and attach access log.

Miguel SRE: snapshot complete and encrypted: s3://rb-legal-staging/cascade-snapshot-1845001234.enc. sha256: abcd... . I set object ACL to private and enabled access-logging.

Priya Sec: I'm drafting the exception email. Key ask to Legal: 48h access window, limited to two engineers, audit log of every read, immediate deletion after confirmation, provide customer-signed addendum.

LegalOpsBot: LR-2026-081: added: scope=debug-only, duration=48h, internal-approvers=[Priya Sec, LegalTeam], customer-approvers=[Dan]. Please upload signed addendum to the request.

Sam EngRuntime: Noted. Also rotated runtime encryption keys for the pool and revoked any stale credentials. Command run: `rb-keys rotate --pool cascade-bank-prod`.

Ruth-CS: I'll push the addendum to Dan separately and confirm when signed. Dan pls ping once you upload.

Dan (CascadeBank): Addendum signed and uploaded to secure link. I also authorized Miguel & Sam by corporate email.

LegalOpsBot: LR-2026-081 status=customer_approved. Internal approval pending LegalTeam review.

Priya Sec: Legal team: please review quick. If we approve, we will create a temporary IAM role with `s3:GetObject` on the encrypted snapshot, require session MFA, and log every action. Also require that the engineers operate inside a restricted bastion with ephemeral sessions.

LegalTeam (via LegalOpsBot): Reviewing now. Expected turnaround ~30–60 minutes. If urgent, escalate to on-call counsel.

Asha (oncall): Handing off to evening oncall @Miguel SRE — I'll update pager duty notes and include the LR ticket and snapshot link. Miguel, keep us posted with any decryption attempts (should be none until legal says).

Miguel SRE: taking handoff. I'll not decrypt until I have explicit approval. Also putting a watch on retry queue to mitigate customer impact (throttle retries to prevent spike).

Sam EngRuntime: Follow-up: I've deployed a short-term filter on runtime that masks sequences that look like SSNs before they hit the logger: `MASK_SSN=true`. This reduces likelihood of future leaks.

Ruth-CS: CascadeBank acknowledged the mitigation and appreciates the 48h boxed process. They want a formal incident postmortem and confirmation of deletion after.

LegalOpsBot: LR-2026-081 internal_approved by LegalTeam at 1845003100. Conditions: 48h window, access audit via CloudTrail, immediate deletion proof required.

Miguel SRE: decrypt request submitted to KMS (role check). Proceeding to decrypt in ephemeral bastion session; recording session video for audit.

IncidentBot: action logged: LR-2026-081 -> snapshot access granted to [Miguel SRE, Sam EngRuntime] at 1845003200. Audit link: https://audit/reports/1845003200

Priya Sec: After triage, we will produce two artifacts: 1) scrubbed diagnostic pack for public postmortem 2) proof of deletion of the sensitive snapshot. Both will be attached to LR-2026-081.

Miguel SRE: triage complete. Root cause: transient model runtime kernel mismatch during a rolling update causing load failures and increased latency, combined with verbose debug mode for that pool. Patch ready and tested.

Dan (CascadeBank): Thanks — CascadeBank confirms 48h window is fine. Please delete snapshot when done and provide deletion receipt.

Miguel SRE: deletion of s3://rb-legal-staging/cascade-snapshot-1845001234.enc initiated and shredding log appended to LR-2026-081. Deletion confirmation sha256 removed.

LegalOpsBot: LR-2026-081 closed at 1845003500. Artifacts attached: scrubbed-diagnostics.zip, deletion_receipt.pdf, audit_trail.csv.

Asha (oncall): Great job team. I'll file a short incident note and schedule the postmortem with the product and CS owners. Lessons: avoid full-body logging in tenant-dedicated pools by default; make redaction toggle safer; update runbooks for legal exception flow. :white_check_mark: 

Ruth-CS: I'll coordinate postmortem agenda with CascadeBank and ensure they get deletion receipt and the scrubbed pack.

IncidentBot: THREAD CLOSED (manual) at 1845003600.
